articles.abstract_en: Recent scholarship has suggested that artificial intelligence (AI) technology and autocratic regimes may be mutually reinforcing. We test for a mutually reinforcing relationship in the context of facial-recognition AI in China. To do so, we gather comprehensive data on AI firms and government procurement contracts, as well as on social unrest across China since the early 2010s. We first show that autocrats benefit from AI: local unrest leads to greater government procurement of facial-recognition AI as a new technology of political control, and increased AI procurement indeed suppresses subsequent unrest. We show that AI innovation benefits from autocrats’ suppression of unrest: the contracted AI firms innovate more both for the government and commercial markets and are more likely to export their products; noncontracted AI firms do not experience detectable negative spillovers. Taken together, these results suggest the possibility of sustained AI innovation under the Chinese regime: AI innovation entrenches the regime, and the regime’s investment in AI for political control stimulates further frontier innovation.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期学术研究表明，人工智能（AI）技术与威权政体可能相互强化。我们以中国人脸识别AI为背景，检验这种相互强化关系。为此，我们收集了自2010年代初以来中国AI企业、政府采购合同以及社会动荡的全面数据。我们首先证明威权者从AI中受益：地方动荡导致政府更多采购人脸识别AI作为政治控制的新技术，而AI采购的增加确实抑制了后续动荡。我们证明AI创新受益于威权者对动荡的压制：中标AI企业在政府和商业市场均进行更多创新，且更可能出口其产品；未中标AI企业未经历可察觉的负面溢出效应。综合来看，这些结果表明在中国体制下AI创新持续存在的可能性：AI创新巩固了体制，而体制为政治控制对AI的投资刺激了进一步的尖端创新。

articles.abstract_en: Dissent plays an important role in any society, but dissenters are often silenced through social sanctions. Beyond their persuasive effects, rationales providing arguments supporting dissenters’ causes can increase the public expression of dissent by providing a “social cover” for voicing otherwise stigmatized positions. Motivated by a simple theoretical framework, we experimentally show that liberals are more willing to post a tweet opposing the movement to defund the police, are seen as less prejudiced, and face lower social sanctions when their tweet implies they had first read credible scientific evidence supporting their position. Analogous experiments with conservatives demonstrate that the same mechanisms facilitate anti-immigrant expression. Our findings highlight both the power of rationales and their limitations in enabling dissent and shed light on phenomena such as social movements, political correctness, propaganda, and antiminority behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 异议在任何社会中都扮演着重要角色，但异议者常常因社会制裁而被迫沉默。除了说服效果之外，为异议者的事业提供论据的理由可以通过为表达原本被污名化的立场提供“社会掩护”来增加异议的公开表达。受一个简单理论框架的启发，我们通过实验表明，自由派更愿意发布一条反对“撤资警察”运动的推文，被视为偏见较少，并且当他们的推文暗示他们首先阅读了支持其立场的可信科学证据时，面临的社会制裁较低。与保守派进行的类似实验表明，同样的机制促进了反移民表达。我们的发现强调了理由的力量及其在促成异议方面的局限性，并揭示了社会运动、政治正确、宣传和反少数群体行为等现象。

articles.abstract_en: Communities across the United States are reconsidering the public safety benefits of prosecuting nonviolent misdemeanor offenses, yet there is little empirical evidence to inform policy in this area. We report the first estimates of the causal effects of misdemeanor prosecution on defendants’ subsequent criminal justice involvement. We leverage the as-if random assignment of nonviolent misdemeanor cases to assistant district attorneys (ADAs) who decide whether a case should be prosecuted in the Suffolk County District Attorney’s Office in Massachusetts. These ADAs vary in the average leniency of their prosecution decisions. We find that for the marginal defendant, nonprosecution of a nonviolent misdemeanor offense leads to a 53% reduction in the likelihood of a new criminal complaint and a 60% reduction in the number of new criminal complaints over the next two years. These local average treatment effects are largest for defendants without prior criminal records, suggesting that averting criminal record acquisition is an important mechanism driving our findings. We also present evidence that a recent policy change in Suffolk County imposing a presumption of nonprosecution for nonviolent misdemeanor offenses had similar beneficial effects, decreasing the likelihood of subsequent criminal justice involvement.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国各地的社区正在重新考虑起诉非暴力轻罪所带来的公共安全利益，然而目前几乎没有实证证据为这一领域的政策提供信息。我们报告了轻罪起诉对被告后续刑事司法介入因果效应的首批估计。我们利用了马萨诸塞州萨福克县地区检察官办公室中非暴力轻罪案件近乎随机分配给助理地区检察官（ADAs）的特点，这些检察官决定案件是否应被起诉。这些ADAs在起诉决定的平均宽严程度上存在差异。我们发现，对于边际被告而言，不起诉非暴力轻罪导致未来两年内新刑事控告的可能性降低53%，新刑事控告的数量减少60%。这些局部平均处理效应在无前科记录的被告中最为显著，表明避免获得犯罪记录是推动我们发现的重要机制。我们还提供了证据表明，萨福克县最近一项对非暴力轻罪实行不起诉推定的政策变化产生了类似的有利影响，降低了后续刑事司法介入的可能性。

articles.abstract_en: Unemployment rates differ widely across local labor markets. I offer new empirical evidence that high local unemployment emerges because of elevated local job-losing rates. Local employers, rather than local workers or location-specific factors, account for most of the spatial gaps in job stability. I propose a theory in which spatial differences in job loss emerge in equilibrium because of systematic differences between employers across local labor markets. The spatial sorting decisions of employers in turn shape heterogeneity across locations. Labor market frictions induce productive employers to overvalue locating close to each other. The optimal policy incentivizes them to relocate toward areas with high job-losing rates, providing a rationale for commonly used place-based policies. I estimate the model using French administrative data. The estimated model accounts for over three-quarters of the cross-sectional dispersion in unemployment rates and for the respective contributions of job-losing and job-finding rates. Inefficient location choices by employers amplify spatial unemployment differentials fivefold. Both real-world and optimal place-based policies can yield sizable local and aggregate welfare gains.
articles.abstract_cn: 失业率在地方劳动力市场之间存在显著差异。我提供了新的经验证据，表明高地方失业率源于较高的地方失业发生率。地方雇主，而非地方工人或地点特定因素，解释了工作稳定性空间差异的大部分。我提出了一种理论，其中失业损失的空间差异在均衡中出现，是因为地方劳动力市场中雇主之间的系统性差异。雇主的空间排序决策反过来塑造了地点之间的异质性。劳动力市场摩擦使得高生产率雇主过度重视彼此靠近的选址。最优政策激励他们向高失业率地区迁移，为常用的地方性政策提供了理论依据。我使用法国行政数据估计了该模型。估计模型解释了失业率横截面离散度的四分之三以上，以及失业发生率和就业发现率的各自贡献。雇主的低效选址选择将空间失业差异放大了五倍。现实世界和最优的地方性政策都能产生可观的局部和总体福利收益。

articles.title_en: The Other Great Migration: Southern Whites and the New Right
articles.title_cn: 另一次大迁徙：南方白人与新右翼
articles.abstract_en: This article shows how the migration of millions of Southern whites in the twentieth century shaped the cultural and political landscape across the United States. Racially and religiously conservative, Southern white migrants created new electoral possibilities for a broad-based coalition with economic conservatives. With their considerable geographic scope, these migrants hastened partisan realignment and helped catalyze and bolster a New Right movement with national influence over the long run. More than just augmenting the conservative voter base outside the South, they influenced non-Southerners by building evangelical churches, diffusing right-wing media, and mixing through intermarriage and residential integration. Tracking non-Southern households, we show that exposure to Southern white neighbors increased adoption of conservative religious norms. Overall, our findings suggest that this mass migration blurred the North–South cultural divide and reshaped the geography of conservatism in the United States.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文展示了二十世纪数百万南方白人的迁徙如何塑造了美国各地的文化和政治格局。南方白人移民在种族和宗教上持保守态度，为与经济保守主义者建立广泛联盟创造了新的选举可能性。凭借其相当大的地理范围，这些移民加速了党派重组，并在长期内帮助催化和支持了一场具有全国影响力的新右翼运动。他们不仅仅是在南方以外增加了保守派选民基础，还通过建立福音派教会、传播右翼媒体以及通过通婚和居住融合来影响非南方人。追踪非南方家庭，我们发现接触南方白人邻居增加了对保守宗教规范的采纳。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，这场大规模迁徙模糊了南北文化鸿沟，并重塑了美国保守主义的地理分布。

articles.title_en: Market Power and Spatial Competition in Rural India
articles.title_cn: 印度农村的市场势力与空间竞争
articles.abstract_en: Market power of intermediaries contributes to the low incomes of farmers in India. I study the role of spatial competition between intermediaries in determining the prices that farmers receive in India by focusing on a law that restricts farmers to selling their goods to intermediaries in their own state. I show that the discontinuities in market power generated by the law translate into discontinuities in prices. Increasing spatial competition by one standard deviation causes prices received by farmers to increase by 6.4%. I propose and estimate a quantitative spatial model of bargaining and trade to shed light on spatial and aggregate implications. Estimates from the structural model suggest that removing the interstate trade restriction in India would increase competition between intermediaries. Thereby average farmer prices and their output would increase by at least 11% and 7%, respectively. The value of the national crop output would increase by at least 18%. However, there are distributional consequences as well, as some farmers stand to lose due to increased local production.
articles.abstract_cn: 中间商的市场势力是印度农民收入低下的原因之一。我通过关注一项限制农民只能在本州内向中间商出售商品的法律，研究了中间商之间的空间竞争在决定印度农民获得的价格中所起的作用。我表明，该法律产生的市场势力不连续性转化为价格的不连续性。空间竞争每增加一个标准差，农民获得的价格就会增加6.4%。我提出并估计了一个关于议价和贸易的定量空间模型，以揭示空间和总体影响。结构模型的估计表明，取消印度的跨州贸易限制将增加中间商之间的竞争。因此，农民的平均价格和产量将分别至少增加11%和7%。全国农作物产出的价值将至少增加18%。然而，也存在分配效应，因为一些农民可能因当地生产的增加而受损。

articles.title_en: Overreaction in Expectations: Evidence and Theory
articles.title_cn: 预期中的过度反应：证据与理论
articles.abstract_en: We investigate biases in expectations across different settings through a large-scale randomized experiment where participants forecast stable stochastic processes. The experiment allows us to control forecasters’ information sets as well as the data-generating process, so we can cleanly measure biases in beliefs. We report three facts. First, forecasts display significant overreaction to the most recent observation. Second, overreaction is stronger for less persistent processes. Third, overreaction is also stronger for longer forecast horizons. We develop a tractable model of expectations formation with costly processing of past information, which closely fits the empirical facts. We also perform additional experiments to test the mechanism of the model.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一项大规模随机实验，研究了不同情境下预期中的偏差，参与者需预测稳定的随机过程。该实验使我们能够控制预测者的信息集以及数据生成过程，从而干净地衡量信念中的偏差。我们报告了三个事实。第一，预测对最近一次观测表现出显著的过度反应。第二，对于持续性较弱的过程，过度反应更强。第三，对于更长的预测期限，过度反应也更强。我们开发了一个易于处理的预期形成模型，该模型包含对过去信息的昂贵处理，与经验事实紧密吻合。我们还进行了额外的实验来检验模型的机制。

articles.title_en: Imperfect Risk Sharing and the Business Cycle
articles.title_cn: 不完全风险分担与经济周期
articles.abstract_en: This article studies the macroeconomic implications of imperfect risk sharing implied by a class of New Keynesian models with heterogeneous agents. The models in this class can be equivalently represented as a representative-agent economy with wedges. These wedges are functions of households’ consumption shares and relative wages, and they identify the key cross-sectional moments that govern the impact of households’ heterogeneity on aggregate variables. We measure the wedges using U.S. household-level data and combine them with a representative-agent economy to perform counterfactuals. We find that deviations from perfect risk sharing implied by this class of models account for only 7% of output volatility on average but can have sizable output effects when nominal interest rates reach their lower bound.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了由一类具有异质性主体的新凯恩斯模型所隐含的不完全风险分担的宏观经济影响。该类模型可以等价地表示为带有楔子的代表性主体经济。这些楔子是家庭消费份额和相对工资的函数，它们识别了控制家庭异质性对总体变量影响的关键横截面矩。我们使用美国家庭层面数据测量楔子，并将其与代表性主体经济相结合进行反事实分析。我们发现，该类模型所隐含的偏离完全风险分担平均仅占产出波动的7%，但当名义利率达到其下限时，可能产生显著的产出效应。

articles.title_en: Cultural Distance and Conflict-Related Sexual Violence
articles.title_cn: 文化距离与冲突相关性暴力
articles.abstract_en: This article examines the relationship between ethnic-based gender norms and conflict-related sexual violence. We generate a novel dyadic data set that contains information on the ethnic identity of all the actors involved in ethnic civil conflicts around the world between 1989 and 2019 and their use of sexual violence. We exploit ethnographic information to construct a new male dominance index at the ethnicity level that captures deep-rooted gender norms. First, we find that male-dominant armed actors are more likely to be perpetrators of sexual violence. Second, we consider the cultural distance in gender norms between the combatants and show that sexual violence is driven by a specific clash of conceptions on the appropriate role of men and women in society: sexual violence increases when the perpetrator is more male dominant than the victim. Additional analyses suggest that gender norms influence both the strategic use of sexual violence for military purposes and the expressive use of sexual violence for private motivations. These patterns are specific to sexual violence and do not explain general violence in a conflict. Differences in other cultural dimensions unrelated to gender are not associated with conflict-related sexual violence.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了基于族裔的性别规范与冲突相关性暴力之间的关系。我们生成了一个新颖的二元数据集，其中包含1989年至2019年间全球族裔内战所有参与者的族裔身份及其使用性暴力的信息。我们利用民族志信息构建了一个新的族裔层面男性主导指数，以捕捉根深蒂固的性别规范。首先，我们发现男性主导的武装行为者更可能成为性暴力的实施者。其次，我们考虑了战斗人员之间性别规范的文化距离，并表明性暴力是由关于男女在社会中适当角色的特定观念冲突所驱动的：当实施者比受害者更具男性主导时，性暴力增加。进一步的分析表明，性别规范既影响性暴力作为军事目的的战略性使用，也影响性暴力作为私人动机的表达性使用。这些模式是性暴力特有的，并不能解释冲突中的一般暴力。与性别无关的其他文化维度差异与冲突相关性暴力无关。

articles.title_en: The Political Economics of Green Transitions
articles.title_cn: 绿色转型的政治经济学
articles.abstract_en: Reducing the emissions of greenhouse gases may be almost impossible without a green transition—a substantial transformation of consumption and production patterns. To study such transitions, we propose a dynamic model, which differs from the common approach in economics in two ways. First, consumption patterns reflect not just changing prices and taxes, but changing values. Transitions of values and technologies create a dynamic complementarity that can help or hinder a green transition. Second, and unlike fictitious social planners, policy makers in democratic societies cannot commit to future policy paths, as they are subject to regular elections. We show that market failures and government failures can interact to prevent a welfare-increasing green transition from materializing or make an ongoing green transition too slow.
articles.abstract_cn: 减少温室气体排放可能几乎不可能实现，除非进行绿色转型——即消费和生产模式的实质性转变。为了研究此类转型，我们提出了一个动态模型，该模型在两个方面不同于经济学中的常见方法。首先，消费模式不仅反映价格和税收的变化，还反映价值观的变化。价值观和技术的转型创造了一种动态互补性，这种互补性可以促进或阻碍绿色转型。其次，与虚构的社会规划者不同，民主社会中的政策制定者无法承诺未来的政策路径，因为他们受制于定期选举。我们表明，市场失灵和政府失灵可能相互作用，从而阻止福利增加的绿色转型实现，或使正在进行的绿色转型过于缓慢。

articles.title_en: Regulating Untaxable Externalities: Are Vehicle Air Pollution Standards Effective and Efficient?
articles.title_cn: 规制不可征税的外部性：车辆空气污染标准是否有效且高效？
articles.abstract_en: The world has 1.4 billion passenger vehicles. How should governments regulate their air pollution emissions? A Pigouvian tax is technologically infeasible. Most countries instead rely on exhaust standards that limit air pollution emissions per mile for new vehicles. We assess the effectiveness and efficiency of these standards, which are the centerpiece of U.S. Clean Air Act regulation of transportation, and counterfactual policies. We show that the air pollution emissions per mile of new U.S. vehicles has fallen spectacularly, by over 99%, since standards began in 1967. Several research designs with a half century of data suggest that exhaust standards have caused most of this decline. Yet exhaust standards are not cost-effective in part because they fail to encourage scrap of older vehicles, which account for the majority of emissions. To study counterfactual policies, we develop an analytical and a quantitative model of the vehicle fleet. Analysis of these models suggests that tighter exhaust standards increase social welfare and increasing registration fees on dirty vehicles yields even larger gains by accelerating scrap, although both reforms have complex effects on inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球有1.4亿辆乘用车。政府应如何规制其空气污染排放？庇古税在技术上不可行。大多数国家转而依赖限制新车每英里空气污染排放的尾气标准。我们评估了这些标准（美国《清洁空气法》对交通规制核心内容）以及反事实政策的有效性和效率。我们表明，自1967年标准实施以来，美国新车的每英里空气污染排放量已大幅下降，降幅超过99%。基于半个世纪数据的多项研究设计表明，尾气标准是造成这一下降的主要原因。然而，尾气标准并非成本有效，部分原因在于它们未能鼓励淘汰占排放多数的老旧车辆。为研究反事实政策，我们开发了车辆 fleet 的分析和定量模型。对这些模型的分析表明，更严格的尾气标准能提高社会福利，而对脏污车辆提高注册费通过加速淘汰能带来更大收益，尽管这两项改革对不平等都有复杂影响。

articles.title_en: Visual Inference and Graphical Representation in Regression Discontinuity Designs
articles.title_cn: 回归不连续设计中的视觉推断与图形表示
articles.abstract_en: Despite the widespread use of graphs in empirical research, little is known about readers’ ability to process the statistical information they are meant to convey (“visual inference”). We study visual inference in the context of regression discontinuity (RD) designs by measuring how accurately readers identify discontinuities in graphs produced from data-generating processes calibrated on 11 published papers from leading economics journals. First, we assess the effects of different graphical representation methods on visual inference using randomized experiments. We find that bin widths and fit lines have the largest effects on whether participants correctly perceive the presence or absence of a discontinuity. Our experimental results allow us to make evidence-based recommendations to practitioners, and we suggest using small bins with no fit lines as a starting point to construct RD graphs. Second, we compare visual inference on graphs constructed using our preferred method with widely used econometric inference procedures. We find that visual inference achieves similar or lower type I error (false positive) rates and complements econometric inference.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管图形在实证研究中被广泛使用，但关于读者处理图形所要传达的统计信息的能力（“视觉推断”）知之甚少。我们在回归不连续（RD）设计的背景下研究视觉推断，通过测量读者如何准确地识别从基于11篇来自顶级经济学期刊的已发表论文校准的数据生成过程所产生的图形中的不连续性。首先，我们使用随机实验评估不同图形表示方法对视觉推断的影响。我们发现，箱宽和拟合线对参与者是否正确感知不连续性的存在或缺失影响最大。我们的实验结果使我们能够向实践者提出基于证据的建议，并建议使用无拟合线的小箱作为构建RD图形的起点。其次，我们将使用我们首选方法构建的图形上的视觉推断与广泛使用的计量经济推断程序进行比较。我们发现，视觉推断实现了相似或更低的I型错误（假阳性）率，并补充了计量经济推断。
